entries.message: A login's notes and code key that move into iCloud Keychain while Crest tidies a Space are kept, never removed as left behind.
Add Password closes when the Space it was opened on changes, and saves only to that Space.
When imported notes or codes can't be saved, Settings asks to add them to those passwords by hand, since importing the file again wouldn't.
Add Password waits until the Space's passwords have loaded, so it can tell an account that's already saved.
The New Password sheet can't be changed while it saves, so what's saved is what was typed.
